description: This file implements a checklist box UI component for ncurses-based dialogs, including rendering list items, scroll indicators, buttons, and handling user input.

methods.name: void print_item(WINDOW * win,int choice,int selected)
methods.description: Prints a list item with selection and tagging visuals at a specified position in the window.

methods.name: void print_arrows(WINDOW * win,int choice,int item_no,int scroll,int y,int x,int height)
methods.description: Displays scroll indicator arrows based on the scroll position and list size.

methods.name: void print_buttons(WINDOW * dialog,int height,int width,int selected)
methods.description: Displays 'Select' and 'Help' buttons at the bottom of the dialog.

methods.name: int dialog_checklist(const char * title,const char * prompt,int height,int width,int list_height)
methods.description: Main function to create and handle a checklist dialog with user interaction, scrolling, and selection.

ctags.name: dialog_checklist
ctags.pattern: /^int dialog_checklist(const char *title, const char *prompt, int height,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * title,const char * prompt,int height,int width,int list_height)

ctags.name: print_arrows
ctags.pattern: /^static void print_arrows(WINDOW * win, int choice, int item_no, int scroll,$/
ctags.signature: (WINDOW * win,int choice,int item_no,int scroll,int y,int x,int height)

ctags.name: print_buttons
ctags.pattern: /^static void print_buttons(WINDOW * dialog, int height, int width, int selected)$/

ctags.name: print_item
ctags.pattern: /^static void print_item(WINDOW * win, int choice, int selected)$/
